evidence_jobs.title: Principal Platform Engineer
evidence_jobs.quote: We've invested heavily in forward-deployed engineers at the customer edge. Now we're strengthening the hub.

talk_track: Ben Cole here - I build the platform and reliability layer underneath technical founders at 20-200-person B2B SaaS companies; at Lexipol that meant a first-attempt SOC 2 Type II and 22% off the AWS bill. Your Principal Platform Engineer posting says it plainly: 'We've invested heavily in forward-deployed engineers at the customer edge. Now we're strengthening the hub.' Read another way, that is one open req carrying SLOs, incident response, on-call, and capacity planning for a platform that rockets and eVTOLs run on - while seven forward-deployed roles keep pulling investment back to the edge. In my experience the hub problem is ownership before it is headcount: someone has to define the reliability practices before a principal hire can raise the bar inside them. That is the layer I have built four times, from Expedia to Pokemon, without touching the product roadmap. Who owns your SLOs until that role is filled?
